query:
UPDATE projects SET
            title           = COALESCE($2, title),
            description     = COALESCE($3, description),
            requirements    = COALESCE($4, requirements),
            estimated_hours = COALESCE($5, estimated_hours),
            is_published    = COALESCE($6, is_published),
            updated_at      = NOW()
        WHERE id=$1
